title: Bluegate Business Storage Account: Authorized Users, Account Terms and Program Services
content:
The terms of a Bluegate Business Storage Account — its credit limit, its invoice terms and its authorized users — are changed under the rules below, and the services available to the account and its authorized users follow the program.

## Account terms and users

- **Authorized users.** The account may have up to the program's number of authorized users.
- **Net terms.** Net terms longer than the program's invoice terms are offered only after the program's required number of months of on-time payment.
- **Credit limit review.** The credit limit is reviewed at the program's credit limit review interval, in months.
- **Status for changes.** Terms and users are changed only while the account is in active status, as the business account's status in the company's records shows.

## Program services

- Authorized users get 24-hour gate access where the program provides after-hours access.
- Use of the loading dock, of flatbed carts and dollies, of business center Wi-Fi and of letter mail handling follows what the program provides for each.
- Billing of agreements at several facilities on one account, a named account manager and the application of a sales-tax exemption certificate follow what the program provides for each.
- Deliveries needing a signature are accepted where the program accepts them.

## Account status and changes

| Account status in the records | Terms or users may be changed |
|---|---|
| Active | Yes |
| Credit hold | No |
| Application review | No |
| Closed | No |
| Declined | No |

## Illustrations (hypothetical programs)

- *Users:* on a program allowing 4 authorized users, an account with 3 may add a fourth; with 4 already on the account, the fourth is the last the program allows.
- *Net terms:* on a program with 15-day invoice terms and 6 months of on-time payment required, an account with 4 months of on-time payment is not offered terms longer than 15 days; after 6 months of on-time payment, longer net terms may be offered on review.
- *Status:* an active account asking to change its invoice terms may have the change made; the same account on credit hold may not until it is active again.
